A '''pulsar''' was located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It was believed that the [[Star/Legends|star]] had become a [[Pulsar/Legends|pulsar]] due to experiments by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]].
